gameplay.combat_desc: Combat is turn-based on a grid. On your turn you spend Action Points (AP) to cast spells and Movement Points (MP) to move. Line of sight is a per-spell flag — most spells need it, some don't. You fight mob groups in the world and other players in the Kolizeum. Damage scales with the matching elemental stat and any raw damage bonus.
gameplay.crit_desc: Each spell or weapon has its own base crit rate, written as a 1 in N chance. Critical reduces N, but the final rate can never exceed 1 in 2 (50%).
gameplay.crit_bonus_desc: On a critical hit the spell applies its dedicated critical effects (stronger damage or extra effects) in place of its normal ones.
gameplay.blocking_desc: Some spells grant a shield that soaks incoming damage of a matching element until it is used up. There is no stamina or guard stance, shields are the only damage absorption.
gameplay.resistance_desc: Elemental resistance is a percentage reduction applied to the final damage, capped at 60% per element. Negative resistance (a weakness) amplifies the damage instead.
gameplay.life_steal_desc: Drain spell effects deal damage and heal the caster for half of the health the target actually loses. Only a player's drain heals: a mob casting the same spell deals its damage and heals nothing.
gameplay.life_steal_note: Damage runs through the standard damage formula first, then the caster heals for half of the health the intended target actually lost — a hit redirected onto another fighter, or one the target converts into healing, steals nothing back.
gameplay.healing_desc: Heals apply the spell's authored base value, scaled up by a percentage of your Intelligence, plus a flat Heal bonus from gear and buffs. Healing is capped at the target's maximum health.
gameplay.heal_bonus_value: Flat bonus from gear/buffs, added after the Intelligence scaling
gameplay.healing_mobs_value: Scale with Intelligence only, no heal bonus
gameplay.leveling_desc: Max level is 200. Fight mobs within your level range for optimal XP.
gameplay.loot_desc: Each drop entry has its own fixed chance, rolled independently when the mob dies. Quantity is random within the entry's range.
gameplay.stat_rolling_desc: Each stat is rolled uniformly within its template range. Every value is equally likely.
gameplay.archimobs_desc: 0.5% chance to spawn as the mob's archimob instead — a named, permanently stronger variant. The only rarity mechanic mobs have.
gameplay.groups_desc: A party is a shared roster of up to {{max}} players with leader election. Being partied does nothing by itself in a fight — everyone, partied or not, must send their own join-fight transaction to enter; there is no passive or proximity inclusion.
gameplay.groups_xp_desc: A won fight's total XP splits evenly across every fighter in it, then each player's own Wisdom and the mob group's age bonus apply on top. How much damage you personally dealt does not change your share.
gameplay.groups_loot_desc: Loot is not split. Every winning fighter independently rolls the mob group's full loot table using their own Chance stat — a bigger party never shrinks anyone's odds.
gameplay.dungeons_desc: Dungeons are entered from anywhere in their world with a key — no group instance: every keyholder inside shares the same space, just like the open world.
gameplay.dungeon_entry_value: Key item, from anywhere in the world
gameplay.dungeon_instance_value: Shared — every keyholder sees each other
gameplay.classes_desc: 12 classes. Weapons are universal — any class can equip and use any weapon type — but wielding the weapon designed for your class grants +10% damage and crit damage. Each class unlocks its spells at fixed levels as you rank up.
gameplay.marketplace_desc: Gear and characters list on the kiosk at any price you set; buyers pay instantly. Resources trade against SUI in swap pools instead, no listings. Every sale pays a 10% royalty — the marketplace is the only way to sell.
gameplay.forgemagie_desc: Forgemagie is the rune crafting system. Crush equipment into runes, then apply those runes to other gear to modify its stats. A high-risk, high-reward endgame system for perfecting equipment.
gameplay.crushing_desc: Each stat line on the crushed item rolls independently — higher stat values and heavier stats produce more runes. There is no server: the yield divisor combines a fixed per-item-level curve with the item template's own taux, a shared on-chain inflation coefficient (1%-4000%) that crushing itself pushes down for that template and up for its neighbors.
gameplay.crushing_tiers_desc: Rune tier (Ba/Pa/Ra) is selected probabilistically. Higher stat values bias toward Ra runes.
gameplay.rune_ra: Tier 3: highest weight per rune, double XP
gameplay.rune_weight_desc: Each rune has a weight equal to its value multiplied by the stat's unit weight. Weight is auto-computed.
gameplay.rune_table_note: Range, Movement, and Action runes apply once each; Critical Chance up to 10 times. Critical and Critical Outcomes have no rune at all.
gameplay.stat_unit_weights_desc: Each stat has a unit weight reflecting its combat power. Items with heavy stat lines yield more runes when crushed, consume more item budget, and are harder to over-mage.
gameplay.rune_application_desc: Unlocks at level 70 in ANY job — gathering or crafting, whichever you leveled first. Apply runes to equipment, one at a time, to modify its stats. Three outcomes are possible:
gameplay.outcome_neutral_desc: Rune passes, other stats may decrease
gameplay.outcome_critical_failure_desc: Rune fails, stats lost equal to rune weight
gameplay.success_rate_desc: Success depends on how close the stat is to its maximum: near 0% is ~99% success, near max is ~50%, and exotic stats sit at ~1% regardless of level. Whether a success lands Critical (no loss) or Neutral (weight paid) shifts the same way, plus a small +0.2% per job level above 1. There is no cap on which item level your job can work on.
gameplay.puits_desc: A weight counter, shown in the UI, that accumulates when stat losses exceed the rune weight. It absorbs future losses before other stats are affected. Resets when the item leaves the forgemagie workbench.
gameplay.over_maging_desc: Push stats above their natural maximum. Each stat line is capped at 101 extra weight. Max over-mage depends on the stat's unit weight — a light stat like Vitality (weight 0.2) can be pushed ~505 points over, a heavy one like Wisdom (weight 3) only ~33.
gameplay.forgemagie_tips_desc: For exotic/over-mage: strip cheap stats first to build a large sink, then pass the hard stat while buffered, then re-add lost stats (easy since they're far below max). Don't move the item during a session. The sink resets. Over-maged and exotic stats are lost first on failure.
gameplay.forgemagie_xp_desc: XP is awarded only on success (Critical or Neutral). Higher level items and heavier runes give significantly more XP. Ra runes grant double XP compared to Ba and Pa runes. Formula: max(1, runeWeight × (1 + itemLevel / 50) × tierMultiplier) where tierMultiplier is 2 for Ra, 1 otherwise.
gameplay.wisdom_xp_desc: Wisdom boosts all the XP you earn. At 600 Wisdom you gain double XP, with diminishing returns above that.
gameplay.chance_loot_desc: Your Chance stat raises the drop rate of every loot entry. At 700 Chance each drop rate is doubled. A drop rate can never exceed guaranteed.

wallet.faq_what_is_sui_answer: SUI is a digital currency, like digital cash. It lives on a fast, secure network called the Sui blockchain. You use small amounts of SUI to buy items in the AresRPG shop. Think of it like game credits, except we can't take them from you.
wallet.faq_why_sui_answer: SUI is our preferred payment method. Transactions are instant (under 1 second) and cost fractions of a cent. No middleman fees. We may support traditional currencies (USD, EUR, etc.) in the future, but that requires significant legal work and comes with heavy fees and taxes we're not ready to take on yet.
wallet.faq_legal_answer: Yes. Buying and holding cryptocurrency is legal in most countries. SUI is a legitimate digital asset traded on major regulated exchanges worldwide. You're simply using it as a payment method to spend on our shop. No NFTs, no crypto schemes.
wallet.faq_eula: Is it allowed by the game's terms?
wallet.faq_eula_answer: Yes. As long as cryptocurrency is used solely as a payment method and doesn't involve NFTs or speculative crypto schemes, it's fully compliant. Many major game stores even support crypto payments.
wallet.faq_access_answer: Only you. Your wallet is created from your Google login using Sui's zkLogin technology. Nobody (not even the AresRPG team) can access your funds or move them. Important: this wallet is meant for shop purchases only. Do not store large amounts here. Deposit only what you plan to spend.
wallet.faq_balance: I sent SUI but my balance didn't update?
wallet.faq_balance_answer: No worries. Our refresh system might be temporarily slow. Double check that you sent SUI to the correct address (copy it from above), and if it still doesn't show up, contact the team on Discord with your transaction ID for further help.

spells.spell_rending_claw_desc: A cutting claw charged with water rends the target.
spells.spell_beast_roar_desc: A territorial bellow that cows and cuts a whole cluster at once.
spells.spell_emberbolt_desc: A crackling ember bolt — a steady fire attack.
spells.spell_stoneward_desc: A crust of packed stone over an ally — earth's blows glance away.
spells.spell_bulwark_desc: Raise a ward that boosts resistance to all elements.
spells.char_busy: That character is busy and can't level up spells right now.
spells.spell_warcleave_desc: A heaving two-hand swing that shoulders through guard — the warrior's opening word.
spells.spell_vault_desc: Vault the gap and land inside their reach; distance is the enemy's only defence.
spells.spell_oathblade_desc: A blade lit white-hot that bites deepest on a true strike.
spells.spell_war_bellow_desc: A bellowing shove that drives a foe back two paces and rattles their footing.
spells.spell_draghook_desc: Hook the coward and drag them into the kill-range they were fleeing.
spells.spell_gash_desc: A slashing cut that leaves the wound raw — every hit after lands harder.
spells.spell_battle_trance_desc: Read the fight, breathe, and let the next blows fall where armour is thinnest.
spells.spell_fate_s_edge_desc: A committed downstroke that trades finesse for raw, fate-sealing weight.
spells.spell_maim_desc: Carve deep; the ruin you deal sharpens your own edge for the blows that follow.
spells.spell_gust_blade_desc: A blade-driven gale that carves a straight lane and blows the line off it.
spells.spell_ironsurge_desc: Roar and set your feet — for a few turns every strike is a heavier one.
spells.spell_warheart_desc: Refuse to fall: swell with borrowed life and outlast the exchange.
spells.spell_executioner_s_arc_desc: A verdict delivered edge-first, and on a true strike there is no appeal.
spells.spell_battle_breath_desc: Steal a breath from the clock and find one more swing in it.
spells.spell_ruinstroke_desc: A wrecking arc meant for armour, shields, and whatever hides behind them.
spells.spell_skyfall_edge_desc: A skyward cleave that falls in a straight bright line through everything in it.
spells.spell_steel_tempest_desc: Spin into a whirlwind of steel and let no one near you stand clean.
spells.spell_cleaving_wrath_desc: An overhead ruin that splits the ground and hurls the survivors back.
spells.spell_focused_strike_desc: Everything into one point: the cheapest heavy blow you will ever throw.
spells.spell_godcleaver_desc: Four turns to raise it, one to bring it down — the single biggest blow the game knows.
spells.spell_gutterknife_desc: A flicked dagger that finds a kidney from four paces — cheap, quiet, repeatable.
spells.spell_vanish_desc: Fold into your own shadow and be gone; at mastery you slip a step further.
spells.spell_fanged_snare_desc: A hidden bite laid on the floor — the enemy finds it the hard way, once.
spells.spell_prowler_s_eye_desc: The prowler's eye stretches every line of sight near it — yours, and your packmates'.
spells.spell_patient_venom_desc: A blade wiped in something patient — it works while you walk away.
spells.spell_dread_whisper_desc: A whispered threat that sends a foe stumbling three cells from your reach.
spells.spell_killer_s_calm_desc: Still the breath, sharpen intent — the next wounds you open run deeper.
spells.spell_snaptrap_desc: A snare that eats a victim's footing the instant they blunder onto it.
spells.spell_fleece_desc: Con them out of a step and pocket it — a cut that robs as it wounds.
spells.spell_vial_snare_desc: A hidden vial that breaks underfoot and seeps for turns after.
spells.spell_nightsurge_desc: Pour it all into the arms for a beat — the next thrust hits like a hammer.
spells.spell_springjaw_desc: A trap meant to fling them off; until the spring is wired, it simply detonates where they stand.
spells.spell_false_trail_desc: Point their eyes the wrong way; their guard follows and gaps open.
spells.spell_mute_snare_desc: A hush laid on the floor — step in and the words for spells won't come.
spells.spell_seeking_blade_desc: A dagger thrown to curve around cover and find the throat behind it.
spells.spell_cold_slit_desc: A chilled edge that stiffens the blood and slows every step after.
spells.spell_field_of_fangs_desc: A wide-mouthed snare that swallows a whole cluster when the first one trips it.
spells.spell_quietus_desc: The whole kit was for this: one point-blank thrust that almost always kills.
spells.spell_coffin_snare_desc: A trap built to finish, not to warn — it burns as it bites.
spells.spell_death_mark_desc: Name the target, take their footing, take their life — the assassin's last word.
spells.spell_blood_toll_desc: An axe-fall that hits harder the closer you are to death — bleed to win.
spells.spell_chainhaul_desc: Reach out and haul a distant foe three cells into the meat-grinder.
spells.spell_warfrenzy_desc: Stoke the rage; for a few turns the axe swings with a madman's weight.
spells.spell_reckless_toll_desc: A reckless fire-wreathed chop that scales with your own suffering.
spells.spell_bullcharge_desc: Charge the line — cover the ground in a heartbeat and open with a body-check.
spells.spell_whirling_toll_desc: A whirling low cut, faster the worse your wounds, catching all who crowd you.
spells.spell_ironboot_desc: A boot to the chest that buys room or shoves a foe onto worse ground.
spells.spell_fester_desc: A tainting blow that eats their fire-guard and closes their wounds to healing.
spells.spell_bloodletting_desc: Open your own veins for power — pay in HP, collect in raw strength.
spells.spell_drowning_toll_desc: A drowning-cold retribution that swells as your own life ebbs.
spells.spell_blood_rage_desc: Full berserk: monstrous strength bought with a slice of your own blood.
spells.spell_leech_wound_desc: Tear a wound and drink from it — their loss is your patched-up life.
spells.spell_soul_tether_desc: Bind a soul to yours and reel it four cells in, wherever it hid.
spells.spell_martyr_s_call_desc: Demand their attention the crude way — today by dulling them, not chaining aggro.
spells.spell_pain_pact_desc: Brace to share every blow's cost; for now that reads as thicker hide.
spells.spell_furious_blow_desc: A wild, undirected swing that trusts strength to sort out the rest.
spells.spell_wrathring_desc: A ring of retribution — the lower your life, the wider the ruin.
spells.spell_blood_trade_desc: Trade places with a victim — for now, a violent yank in your direction.
spells.spell_bloodthirst_desc: A heavy feeding blow that opens them and closes you in the same motion.
spells.spell_berserk_desc: The last madness: everything you have left, thrown at everyone at once.
spells.spell_thornlash_desc: A thorn-vine lashes out from the earth to rake a foe at range.
spells.spell_gripgrass_desc: Grasping grass snarls their ankles and steals the ground from under them.
spells.spell_rotbreath_desc: A sickly gust that rots vigour and lingers in the lungs for turns.
spells.spell_quakebed_desc: A patch of ground set shuddering — stand on it and the earth bites back.
spells.spell_spiteful_thorn_desc: A cheekier, harder-swinging vine for when a single thorn won't do.
spells.spell_numbing_sap_desc: A venom that both sickens and roots — every turn a little slower, a little weaker.
spells.spell_wildfire_desc: Dry brush set alight — a spreading burn that scorches a whole cluster.
spells.spell_rooting_glyph_desc: Where a Mori once grew a tree, roots erupt to pin whoever stands there.
spells.spell_thorn_chorus_desc: A thicket bursts upward, thorns taking everyone caught in the patch.
spells.spell_dewmend_desc: A drop of living water that knits an ally's wounds closed.
spells.spell_briarburst_glyph_desc: An old hex of living briar, distilled into a burning zone that punishes the standing.
spells.spell_savage_briar_desc: Vines that strike first and ask nothing — cheap, mean, and quick to master.
spells.spell_entangle_glyph_desc: The Blocker becomes a bog: everything inside is slowed and steadily poisoned.
spells.spell_nature_s_knowledge_desc: Commune with the wild and let its old cunning sharpen your castings.
spells.spell_overgrowth_desc: Unchecked growth chokes a foe — a poison that only worsens with time.
spells.spell_briarwall_desc: A living hedge thrown up around an ally to blunt the blows meant for them.
spells.spell_sacrificial_thorns_desc: The Sacrificial doll's final gift: a bursting ring of thorns where it stood.
spells.spell_poison_bloom_desc: A flower of rot opens over a zone, seeping into all who linger.
spells.spell_nature_s_wrath_desc: The forest's patience runs out — one crushing, root-and-branch blow.
spells.spell_forest_s_fury_desc: The whole grove rises at once; the ground itself takes its due.
spells.spell_hourshard_desc: A splinter of stopped time, flicked like a dart into a foe.
spells.spell_stolen_beat_desc: Steal a tick from their clock — one fewer action, one turn closer to helpless.
spells.spell_timeslip_desc: Fold the space between two cells and simply be elsewhere.
spells.spell_winterhand_desc: A chilling touch that both wounds and clogs their movement.
spells.spell_smear_desc: Smear yourself across a half-second — harder to hit, harder to pin.
spells.spell_duskbeam_desc: A beam of spent hours lanced straight down the cast line.
spells.spell_clockdrag_desc: Wind their clock backward: fewer steps, clumsier ones.
spells.spell_borrowed_hour_desc: Gift a stolen moment to a comrade — an extra action, freely given.
spells.spell_pendulum_fist_desc: A fist wrapped in condensed time; it lands with the weight of a wasted hour.
spells.spell_decay_touch_desc: Age a limb a decade in an instant — it wounds and it robs an action.
spells.spell_rewind_step_desc: Rewind your own position to safety when the line collapses.
spells.spell_grand_dial_desc: Set a great dial spinning on the board — its ring scours whoever stands within.
spells.spell_hourdust_desc: Scatter the residue of eaten seconds; it settles as damage over a whole zone.
spells.spell_hourthief_desc: Don't just deny their action — take it, and spend it yourself.
spells.spell_seeker_shard_desc: A needle loosed to curve around cover and find its mark regardless.
spells.spell_dialstep_desc: Spin the dial and step onto it — a repositioning trick, half of it still to come.
spells.spell_backtick_desc: Brace against the next blow's echo; for now it simply thickens your guard.
spells.spell_gauzebind_desc: Bind a foe in slow, cold time — it crushes and it locks an action away.
spells.spell_nightlance_desc: A lance of pure elapsed time, straight and merciless down the line.
spells.spell_the_last_grain_desc: Upend the glass: drain their turn to nothing and bury them in the fallout.
spells.spell_wrathmark_desc: Chalk a hostile rune on the floor; it lashes whatever dares to stand on it.
spells.spell_mistjab_desc: A jab of stormcloud loosed from the staff at range.
spells.spell_emberward_desc: A shimmer of heat-ward that drinks the sting from flame.
spells.spell_cindermark_desc: A burning sigil that sears anyone lingering in its circle, turn after turn.
spells.spell_tideward_desc: A sheath of still water that turns aside the cold and the drowning blow.
spells.spell_bastion_step_desc: Blink to a better cell — a guardian must stand in the right place.
spells.spell_galeward_desc: A cushion of moving air that softens the swift, cutting strike.
spells.spell_aegis_sigil_desc: A raised ward over a comrade — today it bolsters their life rather than capping the hit.
spells.spell_hushmark_desc: A hush-rune on the floor; stand in it and the AP for spellcraft drains away.
spells.spell_glaremark_desc: A glare-sigil that leaves those within fumbling and easy to strike.
spells.spell_bookbound_might_desc: Old book-learning of the stave — for a while your own blows land heavier.
spells.spell_sanctum_sphere_desc: A shimmering sphere around an ally that turns every element aside at once.
spells.spell_measured_riposte_desc: A guardian's riposte — patient, then suddenly and precisely brutal.
spells.spell_cloud_storm_desc: The gentle cloud turns thunderhead and breaks over a whole zone.
spells.spell_lifelend_desc: Pour a measure of your own endurance into a failing comrade.
spells.spell_white_accord_desc: Call a moment of peace over the line — the party weathers everything, briefly.
spells.spell_adamant_oath_desc: Plant your feet and become, for a heartbeat, very nearly untouchable.
spells.spell_judgment_glyph_desc: A verdict written wide on the floor; the guilty are those who stand upon it.
spells.spell_mirror_covenant_desc: The Shugo's crown jewel — someday it hurls their spell back; today, an absolute ward.
spells.spell_whistling_shaft_desc: A humming shaft loosed clean across the board — the archer's bread and butter.
spells.spell_rimeshot_desc: An ice-tipped shot that stings and stiffens the legs it hits.
spells.spell_skip_shot_desc: A blunt shaft to the chest that buys back the distance a melee just closed.
spells.spell_adder_shaft_desc: A tipped arrow that keeps working long after it's loosed.
spells.spell_cinder_shaft_desc: A fire-fletched shot for when a target needs more than a prick.
spells.spell_deadeye_draw_desc: A held breath and a perfect release — devastating on a true strike.
spells.spell_horizon_draw_desc: Reach out and touch something from where it can't touch you.
spells.spell_hawkgaze_desc: Sight lines open up; for a while your arrows fly farther than they should.
spells.spell_full_draw_desc: A full-draw shot with your whole back behind it.
spells.spell_leech_shaft_desc: A leeching shaft that mends you a little for every wound it opens.
spells.spell_hobble_shot_desc: A weighted arrow that drags a runner to a crawl.
spells.spell_grudge_shaft_desc: A vengeful shot that bites harder the more desperate the archer.
spells.spell_burning_volley_desc: A single expiation-arrow loosed from far off — a cold, patient shot that punishes distance.
spells.spell_string_discipline_desc: Fall into the rhythm of the draw; every shot comes faster and truer.
spells.spell_vulture_shot_desc: A nagging shaft that pecks away at both their steps and their spells.
spells.spell_powder_shaft_desc: A shot that bursts on impact and takes the neighbours with it.
spells.spell_razor_shaft_desc: A broadhead that cuts on the way in and out.
spells.spell_hound_shot_desc: A shot loosed down a clean straight lane to hound a distant mark.
spells.spell_sunpiercer_desc: A long, blazing shot that runs a line of fire clean through the field.
spells.spell_ruin_shaft_desc: The archer's masterpiece — one shot that ends the argument at any distance.
spells.spell_spade_hurl_desc: Hurl the old spade end-over-end into a foe's teeth.
spells.spell_rustkey_desc: Turn an unseen key and lock a step out of their legs.
spells.spell_greed_desc: Let avarice sharpen you — luckier blows, and a better cut of the loot.
spells.spell_stumblehex_desc: Trip them up with a well-placed jinx; they stumble and slow.
spells.spell_coinshot_desc: Fling a fistful of hot coins — greed weaponised.
spells.spell_spadewheel_desc: Send the spade skipping through a line, clipping everyone it passes.
spells.spell_greased_boots_desc: Grease a comrade's boots — an extra step, right when it counts.
spells.spell_wraithspade_desc: A spectral spade conjured from thin air, swung by no visible hand.
spells.spell_goldlust_desc: Pure want, made muscle — the more you crave, the harder you dig.
spells.spell_cursed_strongbox_desc: Crack open a cursed strongbox on the floor and let its spite loose on the standing.
spells.spell_fumblefield_desc: A field of bad luck — a whole cluster trips over its own feet.
spells.spell_old_bones_desc: The obstinacy of an old miser — refuse to die and swell with borrowed years.
spells.spell_earthfill_desc: Heap up a treacherous mound that punishes and jostles those who cross it.
spells.spell_debt_collector_desc: The spade of reckoning, brought down with the weight of every unpaid debt.
spells.spell_restless_spade_desc: The old summoned spade, now a whirl of two vicious digs you swing yourself.
spells.spell_butcher_spade_desc: A butcher's arc of the spade through everything within reach.
spells.spell_miser_s_bolt_desc: Call down a miser's spite as a bolt from a clear sky.
spells.spell_repossession_desc: Strip a foe's protections the greedy way — take what guards them.
spells.spell_prospector_s_wrath_desc: A furious payday of a blow that robs their footing as it lands.
spells.spell_fortune_s_judgment_desc: The final accounting — a zone of ruin that leaves the survivors rooted and poorer.
spells.spell_water_punch_desc: A sopping haymaker that lands with a drunk's careless force.
spells.spell_firegourd_desc: Lob a lit bottle into a crowd and let the fire sort them out.
spells.spell_fumebelch_desc: Belch a cloud of fumes strong enough to knock a foe back two steps.
spells.spell_deep_draught_desc: Take a long pull from the gourd; the drunker you get, the harder you hit.
spells.spell_brandy_knuckle_desc: A punch thrown through a mouthful of firewater — it burns on landing.
spells.spell_caskmend_desc: Fling the cask's dregs in a bursting splash — a cold slap that catches a whole knot of them.
spells.spell_dread_desc: A fearsome roar that sends a foe reeling three cells clear.
spells.spell_barrelstance_desc: Plant your feet like a barrel on the floor — for now, just harder to trip.
spells.spell_breakwater_desc: A sweeping wall of water that breaks over a whole line of foes.
spells.spell_hoist_desc: Scoop up a fighter and haul them along — today, a rough drag toward you.
spells.spell_heave_desc: Heave the one you're carrying across the board — today, a mighty shove.
spells.spell_morning_bell_desc: Inflict the morning after — a pounding, tender-headed vulnerability.
spells.spell_spiritsoak_desc: Douse a foe in spirits so the next flame catches all the deeper.
spells.spell_waterlog_desc: Waterlog their guard until the cold gets straight through.
spells.spell_tavern_hymn_desc: A rolling water-blade thrown on the beat of a drinking song — it finds them across the room.
spells.spell_heavy_swig_desc: One reckless gulp too many — it costs you blood but you hit like a landslide.
spells.spell_cask_tide_desc: Call up a wave and drop it on everything in front of you.
spells.spell_backdraft_belly_desc: Whatever you drank, it's coming back up — and it's on fire.
spells.spell_blue_remedy_desc: A cool blue draught that washes an ally's worst wounds clean.
spells.spell_last_round_desc: Tip the last of the bottle back and drop your guard — one reckless surge of strength and speed.
spells.spell_lashline_desc: A cracking lash that snaps out to sting at a short distance.
spells.spell_ghost_talon_desc: Summon a phantom talon just long enough to rake one foe.
spells.spell_beast_ward_desc: Wrap yourself in the hide of your inner beast; blows of every kind bite less.
spells.spell_rake_desc: A longer, meaner spectral swipe for foes just out of reach.
spells.spell_goad_desc: Nip a comrade into a frenzy — their next blows land with a beast's spite.
spells.spell_wildhide_desc: Toughen skin to bark-and-hide; the earth's blows slide off.
spells.spell_sparrow_aspect_desc: Take the sparrow's quickness — a fluttering, pecking strike and lighter feet.
spells.spell_boar_aspect_desc: Channel the boar: a goring, smouldering charge and hotter blood.
spells.spell_ram_aspect_desc: Lower your head like a war-ram and charge — it hits, it hauls them in.
spells.spell_golem_aspect_desc: Turn your skin to cracked stone — slow to fall, hard to break.
spells.spell_night_howl_desc: A predator's scream that saps the strength from whatever hears it.
spells.spell_quill_aspect_desc: Bristle with iron quills — for now a thorny hide, someday a hide that bites back.
spells.spell_ogre_aspect_desc: Borrow an ogre-mage's crude sorcery and hurl a bolt that bursts over a zone.
spells.spell_crow_strike_desc: A diving black-feather strike out of the sky at range.
spells.spell_wyrmling_breath_desc: Exhale the little dragon's fire in a cone across the front.
spells.spell_toad_slam_desc: Come down with a toad's dead-weight and flatten what's beneath.
spells.spell_lashstorm_desc: A blur of lashes — the whip cracks two, three times before they can flinch.
spells.spell_primal_aspect_desc: Loose every beast at once inside your own skin — faster and far stronger.
spells.spell_menagerie_wrath_desc: The whole bestiary answers in one earth-shaking, all-consuming charge.
spells.spell_coinflip_cut_desc: Flip the coin: it wounds them and mends you, and you never quite know how much.
spells.spell_idle_swat_desc: A cat's idle swat — quick, casual, and repeatable while the mood holds.
spells.spell_alleypounce_desc: Pounce three cells in any direction and land on your feet, as cats do.
spells.spell_charmtoss_desc: Toss a lucky charm that lands as a stinging little curse.
spells.spell_gambler_s_grin_desc: Call on the coin-god's favour; fortune leans your way for a while.
spells.spell_cold_deck_desc: A feinting swipe that both cuts and leaves them second-guessing their footing.
spells.spell_tomcat_temper_desc: Let the big cat wake up inside you — heavier paws, meaner intent.
spells.spell_sharper_s_claw_desc: A greedy raking claw that feeds you as it flays them.
spells.spell_whisker_twitch_desc: Drop into a cat's readiness — everything that comes at you comes slower.
spells.spell_rigged_wheel_desc: Spin the wheel and let its sparks fall where they may across a zone.
spells.spell_raspmend_desc: A cat's rasping lick — crude, and somehow it closes a comrade's wounds.
spells.spell_reverse_desc: Turn the odds inside-out and scatter the fallout over everyone near.
spells.spell_double_down_desc: Coil for the counter; for now that means your own next blows land twice as mean.
spells.spell_card_counter_desc: A cat's read of the room — you strike from a little farther than they expect.
spells.spell_phantom_pounce_desc: Loose a ghost-cat that savages a foe and drags the life back to you.
spells.spell_cash_out_desc: Cut yourself free of the odds with one wild, decisive slash.
spells.spell_all_in_desc: Shove every chip forward — a huge gamble of a blow that pays you back in blood.
spells.spell_ace_of_embers_desc: A fire-blessed strike that, on the right flip, simply removes a problem.
spells.spell_lucky_strike_desc: The improbable perfect blow the whole class was gambling on.
spells.spell_final_wager_desc: Bet the house: a sweeping stroke of fortune that flays the field and heals the cat.
spells.spell_mending_word_desc: Speak the mending word and a comrade's wounds draw quietly closed.
spells.spell_barbed_word_desc: A cutting syllable flung at a foe — the healer's rebuke.
spells.spell_cauterize_desc: Sear a wound shut on an enemy — cruel, and it keeps burning.
spells.spell_gentle_word_desc: A steadier mending spoken across the field to a distant ally.
spells.spell_warding_word_desc: A ward-word murmured over a comrade to blunt what's coming.
spells.spell_rousing_word_desc: A bracing shout that hands an ally one more action this turn.
spells.spell_grim_word_desc: A terrible word that drives a foe stumbling back from the line.
spells.spell_scalpel_wind_desc: A whisper honed to an edge — surgical, and lethal on a true strike.
spells.spell_thirsting_word_desc: A word that opens a foe and pours the stolen vigour into you.
spells.spell_knitting_word_desc: Bless a patch of ground; an ally standing on it mends turn after turn.
spells.spell_springwell_word_desc: A deeper restoring rune underfoot, tending whoever holds the spot.
spells.spell_unspeakable_word_desc: The word a healer swore never to speak — it unmakes rather than mends.
spells.spell_hushing_word_desc: Take the words from their mouth — today by draining the breath for them.
spells.spell_chorus_word_desc: A single word of comfort that reaches every ally in the zone at once.
spells.spell_searing_suture_desc: Stitch a foe's wound shut with fire and leave it smouldering.
spells.spell_binding_word_desc: A binding syllable that roots a foe's feet as it stings.
spells.spell_bleeding_word_desc: Give of your own life so a dying comrade rises — the healer's oldest bargain.
spells.spell_selfless_word_desc: A selfless word — someday it strips their curses too; today it simply heals.
spells.spell_baptism_of_brine_desc: A drowning benediction poured over an unbeliever.
spells.spell_panacea_desc: The word that puts a battered party back together and shields it besides.
